policy: Raw measurements are preserved; known false or uninformative metadata is not. A correction changes only the listed descriptive fields of existing records (point, panel and candidate labels, cohorts and size-axis titles) and adds the listed fields; ids, values, sizes, sources and verdicts are unchanged and no record is removed. Reverting every listed edit reproduces each ledger hash.

reasons.R2: Descriptive model label built from the point's own recorded fields (method style, label, conditions, cohort, sizes, dose) in the inventory's grammar; slots that are not recorded are left out, the teacher is named when it is not Qwen3-8B, and the original label is kept as the variant name.
reasons.R3: Development-GSM decoding corrected from 'greedy' to the sampler the cohort's own job records state.
